issues.description: Sample rate not validated against allowed STTAudioFormat values
issues.detail: The constructor casts `f"pcm_{sample_rate}"` to STTAudioFormat without validation. Passing e.g. sample_rate=32000 or 16001 produces an invalid format string (e.g. `pcm_32000`) that is silently sent to the API, leading to confusing server-side errors. Validate against the literal set in models.py and raise ValueError early.

issues.description: APIConnectionError raised inside recv_task is swallowed by broad except
issues.detail: In `_process_stream_event`, error message types raise `APIConnectionError`, but `recv_task` wraps the call in `except Exception: logger.exception(...)`. This swallows the connection error and the receive loop continues instead of breaking out and reconnecting. Re-raise APIConnectionError (or use a narrower except) so the stream actually surfaces auth/quota errors.

issues.description: Reconnect logic never actually triggers; _reconnect_event is never set
issues.detail: The `_run` loop is built to handle `_reconnect_event`, but nothing sets it. On a normal WebSocket close (closing_ws=True), `recv_task` returns and `tasks_group` completes — the loop then `break`s. There is no retry on transient network failure during a long stream, contradicting typical plugin behavior and `conn_options.max_retry`.

issues.description: API key passed via query string risk and base_url scheme handling
issues.detail: `base_url.replace("https://", "wss://")` works for the default but breaks if a user passes a base_url with a trailing slash or a path; the URL composition then yields `wss://host//speech-to-text/...`. Also, if user supplies a plain `host` with no scheme, no replacement occurs and the ws_connect fails opaquely. Normalize/strip the base_url and validate.

issues.description: tasks_group.exception() may raise InvalidStateError if group is cancelled before completion
issues.detail: After `gracefully_cancel` and `tasks_group.cancel()`, calling `tasks_group.exception()` on a cancelled gather can raise CancelledError/InvalidStateError, masking the original failure. Wrap in a try/except or check `.done()` first.

issues.description: STTModels Literal has trailing comma making it a tuple-style single-value type
issues.detail: `STTModels = Literal["scribe_v2_realtime",]` — the trailing comma is harmless to Literal but signals only one valid value while the type system already allows that. Minor: drop the trailing comma for clarity, or expand once more models exist. Also consider documenting that this is the only supported model.

review.summary: The PR adds a clean STTv2 streaming class following the established Deepgram/Cartesia pattern, but has several correctness gaps. The sample_rate parameter is cast to a constrained Literal without validation, allowing invalid formats to silently reach the server. The error-handling path raises APIConnectionError inside a broad `except Exception` that swallows it. The reconnect plumbing exists but `_reconnect_event` is never set, so the loop won't retry on transient drops. Base URL scheme replacement is fragile, and minor issues exist around cancellation cleanup and Literal style.
